description:
Configure the DHIS2 instance branding for the Sierra Leone Ministry of Health and Sanitation. Log in as admin (admin/district) and navigate to the System Settings app. Configure the following settings:

1. Application Title: 'Sierra Leone HMIS'
2. Application Introduction: 'Welcome to the Sierra Leone Health Information Management System. This platform is managed by the Ministry of Health and Sanitation for authorized health personnel only.'
3. Application Notification: 'System maintenance is scheduled for the last Sunday of each month from 22:00 to 02:00 GMT.'
4. Max number of analytics records: 100000
5. Application Footer: '© 2024 Ministry of Health and Sanitation, Sierra Leone'

Ensure all settings are saved and visible.
